headline: Bajaj Finserv delivered on its Q4-FY25 guidance across all three tracked claims in Q1-FY26. BAGIC's capital-adjusted ROE exceeded the guided 22% threshold, printing at 25%+ ex-surplus capital. BALIC's top-line muting was explicitly anticipated and confirmed, with VNB surging 39% YoY on NBM expansion of 420bps to 11.1%, validating the BALIC 2.0 margin-over-volume thesis.

segments.BAGIC: BAGIC's reported annualized ROE of 21.4% in Q1-FY26 met the guided trajectory; excluding surplus capital at 200% solvency, ROE exceeded 25%, surpassing the guided 22% threshold. PAT grew 15% to INR 660 crores, and core GWP (ex-crop, ex-government health, ex-1/N impact) grew 15% versus industry 14%.
segments.BALIC: Top-line growth remained muted in Q1-FY26 as guided, with retail weighted received premium roughly flat and agency channel continuing to degrow; management reiterated H2-FY26 as the inflection point for meaningful top-line recovery. VNB margin (NBM) expanded 420bps YoY to 11.1%, with VNB up 39% to INR 145 crores, confirming the guided steeper margin trajectory under BALIC 2.0; the full-year VNB margin guidance verdict remains pending pending Q4-FY26 data.

keyThemes: BALIC H2-FY26 top-line recovery: agency channel needs to exit its 3-quarter degrowth streak; watch Q2 agency premium data as the first signal of normalisation

BALIC VNB margin sustainability: NBM at 11.1% in Q1 is a low-base quarter; management's 'far steeper' full-year margin trajectory requires H2 product mix (protection, non-par) to hold at Q4-FY25 levels of ~22% NBM

BAGIC combined ratio trajectory: reported 103.6% in Q1 driven by higher acquisition costs in preferred segments; monitor whether commission pressure in motor and commercial lines compresses underwriting profitability through FY26

Allianz stake acquisition execution: IRDAI and CCI approvals received; first tranche (minimum 6.1%) must close within 6 months of IRDAI approval, with full 26% acquisition deadline of 16 October 2026 — capital deployment and name-change timeline are live watchpoints
